title: Prove exact main artifacts and consumer proof reach release promotion
text: The corrected commit-tag API is served. Candidate code promotes verified exact-main wheel bytes and native image digests, retires tag allocation and reuses exact product/consumer proof. Platform consumer integration of tag-bound exact-pair proof is delivered: the consumer proves the dispatched commit and its release route reuses only a matching successful dispatched run. Production artifact equality and measured Actions savings remain unclaimed until a real release creates or joins exact-pair proof at the release boundary and records its dispatch count and wait. Ordinary producer changes no longer start early proof; retained mandatory release work must be distinguished from avoided runs. No live speed improvement is claimed. Rollout also owes proof that existing relay bootstraps can install numeric release identities before activation.
